name: plmail-e2e
description: End-to-end tests for plMail (Playwright). Separate from the app's AssetMapper/importmap frontend.

scripts.test:unit:docker: npm run test:env:up && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint docker-php-entrypoint app php vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test:e2e:docker:trace: npm run test:env:up && playwright test --trace on --video on
scripts.test:e2e:site: php bin/build-site.php && E2E_SITE=1 playwright test site.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: rm -rf var/js-coverage && E2E_JS_COVERAGE=1 playwright test && node bin/js-coverage.mjs
